rows.jp: 霧は学校に来ているのだろうか。
rows.en: I wonder whether Kiri is at school.

ghs.en: I wonder if Kiri has come to school.

rows.jp: 月曜に見たという記録はなかった。
rows.en: The notebook has no record of anyone seeing her Monday.

ghs.en: There were no records of sightings on Monday.

rows.en: The fourth floor. The first-year classroom.
She stands gazing out at the view.

ghs.en: I gaze lost at this scene.

rows.jp: 筋張ってはおらず、瑞々しい生命力に満ちている。
rows.en: Not bony or stringy, but brimming with fresh young life.

ghs.en: Full of young and fresh vitality that yet doesn't make her muscular.

rows.jp: 斜め後ろから見える横顔にはひとつまみほどの憂い。
rows.en: Seen from just behind, her profile holds the faintest trace of melancholy.

ghs.en: There is just a pinch of sadness, no more, in the profile visible from her shifted back.

rows.jp: 額を覆う仕草で、黒髪がさらさらと波打つ。
rows.en: She lifts a hand to her brow, and her black hair ripples like silk.

ghs.en: Her dark hair waves silky and smooth with the gesture she makes to cover her forehead.

rows.jp: 若い生命力を薄く脆いガラスの膜で覆った……愛すべき少女。
rows.en: A dear girl with all that young life sealed beneath a thin, brittle shell of glass.

ghs.en: A lovable girl... concealed in a thin, brittle glass membrane of youthful vitality.

rows.jp: 傷ついては破片を落とし、時に人を傷つけもする。
rows.en: Every wound knocks loose another shard, and now and then those shards cut someone else.

ghs.en: When hurt she splinters fragments, and those occasionally hurt people.

rows.jp: だが狭い肩から掛かる背中は華奢で、いかにも無防備に見えた。
rows.en: But the back sloping from those narrow shoulders looks so slight, so utterly defenseless.

ghs.en: Yet, the back draping off her narrow shoulders is delicate, so that she appeared completely defenseless.

rows.jp: ……襲いかかってしまいそうなほどに。
rows.en: ...Defenseless enough to make me want to pounce.

ghs.en: ...to the point where I could swoop down on and assault her.

rows.jp: 俺の存在には気づいていないらしい。
rows.en: She doesn’t seem to have noticed me.

ghs.en: She appears not to be aware of my presence.
